en.headline: HKDI free exhibition displays rare photographs of Leslie Cheung until mid-November
en.dek: The Hong Kong Design Institute and the Hong Kong Institute of Professional Photographers present previously unpublished archival images of the late singer alongside student works and a limited-edition vinyl, open…
body: The Hong Kong Design Institute and the Hong Kong Institute of Professional Photographers are staging the free “Leslie・Grace at 70 Exhibition” at the institute’s campus in Tseung Kwan O until 15 November.

The exhibition is divided into three thematic zones. One section features a collection of previously unpublished archival photographs, film negatives and Polaroids of Leslie Cheung from the 1980s and 1990s, many shown publicly for the first time, together with the original silver microphone stand from his “Final Encounter of the Legend Farewell” concert. Another area includes a darkroom installation and creative projects by more than 400 design students, while a limited-edition commemorative vinyl produced with Universal Music Hong Kong is also available.
Entry is free, but visitors must register online in advance. The exhibition is open daily from 10am to 7pm at the Hong Kong Design Institute, 3 King Ling Road, Tseung Kwan O.

zh.headline: 香港知專設計學院免費展覽展出張國榮罕見照片 至11月中
zh.dek: 香港知專設計學院與香港專業攝影師公會合辦「風華70・設計共鳴 哥哥紀念展」，展出多幅首次公開的八、九十年代張國榮珍藏照片，並有學生作品及限量黑膠，需網上預先登記入場。
body: 香港知專設計學院與香港專業攝影師公會在將軍澳校園舉辦免費展覽「Leslie・Grace at 70 Exhibition」（風華70・設計共鳴 哥哥紀念展），展期至11月15日。
展覽分為三個主題區域。其中一區展出多幅八、九十年代拍攝、部分首次公開的張國榮檔案照片、底片及寶麗來，並陳列其「最終演唱會」的原裝銀色咪高峰架。另一區設有暗房裝置，以及超過400名設計學生的創作作品；另有與環球音樂合作製作的限量紀念黑膠唱片。
入場免費，但參觀者須預先網上登記。展覽每日上午10時至晚上7時開放，地點為將軍澳景嶺路3號香港知專設計學院。
